goal: Find real-world implementations of tiling window manager layout save and restore with placeholder windows: i3 and i3-resurrect layout files with swallow criteria, sway swaymsg save/append_layout, swayr window matching, niri scrollable-tiling, PaperWM GNOME session restore, Qtile and awesome-wm layout persistence, and the xdg-session-management Wayland protocol. Extract how each stores a layout template, matches running windows to placeholders, and restores them over IPC, to design bindable space templates (named slots, versioned JSON, Lua binding API) for dawsers/scroll.
